items.summary: Disposition: evidence_needed for fleet-wide security clearance; blocked for security-sensitive public exposure; conditional for ordinary reversible growth. Concrete evidence: fleet-doctor and operational sweeps are unavailable; material security controls are not evidenced; compliance is only a technical baseline with 37 pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown sites; retained worker/reviewer failures are containment signals, not evidence of compromise. Exact decision: continue existing bounded read-only security evidence capture, preserve unknowns, keep private launch gates unchanged, and create no new proposal, change request, requeue, deployment, permission change, credential change, configuration change, dependency addition, telemetry request, or external outreach.
